item.title: Comment on Trumpian policy as cultural policy by Bob
item.description:
Reply to Kevin Burke:

Sure it seems like we might not have a Constitution at the end of this though. If the executive can just do line by line edits of money Congress wants to spend, threaten to withhold/withhold Social Security payments, and ignore the law because impeachment is a dead letter then what are we left with.

On this kind of situation I go to the confirmation hearing of famous woke liberal Antonin Scalia, who was asked about the constitution. He talked about how the Soviet constitution guaranteed more rights than the US constitution, but it was all paper: That what made the US constitution actually had rights that were real was checks and balances, and the interests of people in different branches checking on each other.

I wonder what Scalia would say today about checks and balances, and how wonderful the constitution is.
